title: Agent-driven Model Development for RNA 3D Structure Prediction
authors: Majewski M; Malo L; Montero-Blay A; Marengo M; Gkeka P; Minoux H
one_liner_zh: 该文利用大语言模型智能体半自主开发RNA 3D结构预测模型QuickFold，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其智能体驱动的模型开发框架和结构预测方法对蛋白质结构计算研究具有借鉴意义。
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in driving scientific discovery, but their effectiveness in complex, real-world biological problems remains underexplored. We ask whether a general-purpose LLM agent can drive semi-autonomous development of a model for a genuinely hard biological problem, RNA 3D structure prediction. We designed a development loop where, under a fixed budget and with human supervision, the agent iteratively proposed, implemented, trained, and evaluated model changes. Over 297 iterations, the model evolved from a randomly-initialised baseline to QuickFold, an 8.9 M-parameter folding trunk that matches the strongest open-source baselines (RhoFold+, NuFold) on lDDT and TM-score within noise on a held-out test set at a fraction of their inference cost. We frame this less as a new predictor than as a case study in feedback-driven, agent-led model development.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在推动科学发现方面展现出潜力，但其在复杂、现实世界生物学问题中的有效性仍未得到充分探索。我们探讨一个通用LLM智能体是否能够驱动一个真正困难生物学问题——RNA三维结构预测——模型的半自主开发。我们设计了一个开发循环，在固定预算和人工监督下，智能体迭代地提出、实现、训练并评估模型变更。经过297次迭代，模型从随机初始化的基线演变为QuickFold，一个拥有890万参数的折叠主干，在lDDT和TM-score指标上与最强开源基线（RhoFold+、NuFold）在保留测试集上的噪声范围内相匹配，而其推理成本仅为这些基线的一小部分。我们将其定位为反馈驱动、智能体主导的模型开发案例研究，而非单纯的新预测器。
